jei.robotica.info.servo_core: Dropped by the Scrap Colossus: use a Signal Flare on a Colossus Altar (Rusted Foundry ruins, or crafted). Used for the Servo Drill and the Mob Replicator.
jei.robotica.info.magma_core: Dropped by the Forge Tyrant: use an Ignition Charge on a Forge Altar (Cinder Forge ruins in the Nether, or crafted). Replicator catalyst: blazes, endermen, guardians, ghasts and other tier 3 mobs. Survey Rig core: adds ancient debris and resonite. Blazing Casings use one up.
jei.robotica.info.antigrav_core: Used for Null Casings, Null Drill, Null Lance, Flight Module and Portal Projector. Replicator catalyst: shulkers.
jei.robotica.info.essence_vial: Right-click a hostile mob to take a sample (2 damage, 3 s cooldown). The first sample binds the vial to that mob. Eight samples fill it. Put the full vial in a Replicator.
jei.robotica.info.mainspring: A battery you wind by hand: put it in a Winding Crank and hold right-click with an empty hand, or feed the crank FE. Full in about %s seconds. Powers a robot or machine from its battery slot.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.speed: Machines work faster and use more FE per action.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.range: Robots +2 radius per card, the Excavator +%s blocks wide, the Wireless Charger +%s blocks, the Electric Furnace +1 item per lane.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.efficiency: Machines use 15%% less FE per action per card, never below 40%%. Combustion Generator: %s%% less fuel per card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.fortune: Fortune I to III on mined blocks, more output in the Grinder and Alloy Smelter, Looting in the Replicator. Not with Silk Touch.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.silk: Mined blocks drop themselves. Not with Fortune.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.growth: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.void: Deletes junk (cobblestone, dirt, gravel) and outputs that don't fit.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.height: Architect Table: every card makes the buildings one block taller, up to %2$s high. Built buildings follow.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.carry: Right-click a Storage Terminal with it: the terminal keeps its items when picked up.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.stackable: Stacks in one upgrade slot: each card adds one step, up to %s.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.rules: Right-click a machine with the card, or put it in an upgrade slot. Machines with a Mk have Mk + 1 slots.
